race_instances.title: Clock rcl_clock_ and jump-callback access race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Maintainer-authored and merged thread-safety fix for Clock/Timer access.
race_instances.trigger_condition: clock/timer operation overlaps jump callback registration or dispatch
race_instances.evidence_summary: Common synchronization added for the rcl clock and jump callbacks.
race_instances.strict_reason: Non-thread-safe rcl clock state was concurrently accessed.

race_instances.title: Subscription topic-statistics collectors_ incomplete locking
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged fix adds locking; PR #2592 later closes another path on the same object.
race_instances.trigger_condition: message processing overlaps statistics reset/publish
race_instances.evidence_summary: Existing mutex did not cover all collector access paths.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent container update/read/reset under incomplete locking.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: PR #1084 and follow-up #2592 add the omitted lock coverage.

race_instances.title: Intra-process RingBuffer storage/index data race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Issue closed by merged PR #1213 making RingBuffer access thread-safe.
race_instances.trigger_condition: intra-process callbacks enqueue/dequeue concurrently
race_instances.evidence_summary: RingBuffer implementation gains synchronization.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent non-atomic container/index access without locking.

race_instances.title: Executor node membership and memory strategy thread-safety gap
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged PR explicitly makes add/remove while spinning thread-safe.
race_instances.trigger_condition: node is added/removed while callbacks execute
race_instances.evidence_summary: Executor collection access is synchronized.
race_instances.strict_reason: Thread-safety defect confirmed, but no retained TSan address establishes a strict memory data race.

race_instances.title: TimeSource clock-worker promise publication race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged developer fix orders promise initialization with detach/destruction.
race_instances.trigger_condition: detach/destruction overlaps worker startup
race_instances.evidence_summary: Initialization/publication is ordered before other threads can use the promise.
race_instances.strict_reason: Promise object is used concurrently with initialization/assignment.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: Fix establishes startup ordering absent before PR #1623.

race_instances.title: ActionServer result check/enqueue transaction race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged action-server race fix unifies the check/enqueue transaction.
race_instances.trigger_condition: result publication interleaves between check and enqueue
race_instances.evidence_summary: Two individually locked map operations are made one atomic transaction.
race_instances.strict_reason: Each map access was locked; the defect is cross-operation atomicity.

race_instances.title: NodeBase callback_groups_ vector data race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Changelog says the main purpose is thread-safe callback-group access; commit and backports merged.
race_instances.trigger_condition: callback group is created/removed during executor collection
race_instances.evidence_summary: Callback group container access becomes synchronized.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent vector iteration and mutation.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: No common lock before the thread-safety commit.

race_instances.title: MultiThreadedExecutor timer double-scheduling race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged PR fixes concurrent selection of the same timer.
race_instances.trigger_condition: multiple workers observe a timer ready simultaneously
race_instances.evidence_summary: Executor tracks timers already selected/in use.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent behavior is confirmed but exact non-atomic memory conflict is not public.

race_instances.title: EventsExecutor notification consumed before collection refresh
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged fix repairs notification/refresh ordering state machine.
race_instances.trigger_condition: notification is consumed before refresh finishes
race_instances.impact: flag stuck and later events missed
race_instances.evidence_summary: Collection refresh and notification consumption are correctly ordered.
race_instances.strict_reason: State-machine order violation.

race_instances.title: EventsExecutor current entity collection data race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged PR synchronizes current_entities_collection_.
race_instances.trigger_condition: entity collection is refreshed while callback executes
race_instances.evidence_summary: Current collection gains common locking.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent collection read and mutation.

race_instances.title: TimeSource associated_clocks_ read path omits existing lock

race_instances.trigger_condition: parameter event overlaps clock attach/detach
race_instances.evidence_summary: An existing clock-list mutex was omitted on one path.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent vector/list read and mutation under incomplete locking.

race_instances.title: EventHandler listener callback outlives derived object
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: PR #2102 first reorders callback/handle destruction and removes an unlocked callback read; PR #2349 later closes the same lifetime family at the derived/base boundary.
race_instances.shared_object: rmw listener callback target and derived members
race_instances.actor_2_access: destroy derived state/clear listener too late
race_instances.trigger_condition: middleware callback fires during destruction
race_instances.evidence_summary: The two fixes are treated as one callback-field/rmw-event-handle lineage, not duplicate races.
race_instances.strict_reason: Callback access overlaps object lifetime end.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: Callback/handle member order and later destructor layer were incomplete until #2102/#2349.

race_instances.title: TimeSource callbacks capture raw this across destruction
race_instances.confirmer: Geoffrey Biggs; Ivan Paunovic and reviewers
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged PR explicitly eliminates a callback/destructor race using shared state and weak/shared captures.
race_instances.trigger_condition: callback processing overlaps TimeSource destruction
race_instances.evidence_summary: Callback-required state moves to shared structs captured through safe ownership.
race_instances.strict_reason: Callback dereference overlaps object lifetime end.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: Raw this capture had no destruction barrier before PR #1768.

race_instances.title: ParameterEventHandler callback captures raw this across destruction
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: PR explicitly says destruction interleaved with event processing on another thread can cause a race condition; merged.
race_instances.trigger_condition: parameter event arrives during handler destruction
race_instances.evidence_summary: Callback state moves into a shared struct captured by shared_ptr.
race_instances.strict_reason: Callback dereference overlaps object lifetime end.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: Raw this capture had no destruction barrier before PR #1770.

race_instances.title: Action ClientBase readiness/data handoff race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Issue and multiple fix attempts culminate in merged PR #2495.
race_instances.shared_object: ClientBaseImpl readiness flags/action client handle and handoff data
race_instances.trigger_condition: is_ready, take_data and execute run on different workers out of order
race_instances.evidence_summary: Action client readiness/data transaction gains synchronization.
race_instances.strict_reason: Plain readiness/handle state was accessed across executor threads without sufficient synchronization.

race_instances.title: ClientGoalHandle callbacks race stop/delete
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged PR #2281 puts callback stop/delete under recursive lock.
race_instances.trigger_condition: callback arrives while callbacks are stopped/goal handle deleted
race_instances.evidence_summary: Stop and deletion execute inside the same recursive lock as callbacks.
race_instances.strict_reason: Callback use overlaps destruction of shared callback/goal state.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: Lock scope did not include stop/delete until PR #2281.

race_instances.title: vector<bool> thread_finished packed-word test data race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged PR replaces unsafe packed-bit completion flags.
race_instances.actor_1_access: write distinct logical bits sharing a word
race_instances.trigger_condition: workers update packed bits concurrently
race_instances.evidence_summary: Packed vector<bool> storage is replaced by safe completion synchronization.
race_instances.strict_reason: Writes to different bits conflict on the same underlying word, alongside reads.

race_instances.title: CallbackGroup entity-container size() omits existing lock
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged PR fixes the sole unlocked size path; backports #3059/#3060.
race_instances.trigger_condition: executor reads size while group entities change
race_instances.evidence_summary: Existing group mutex is applied to size().
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent container size read and mutation under incomplete locking.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: size() omitted the existing mutex until PR #3056.

race_instances.title: wait_for_message test expectation ordering race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Direct commit title explicitly says Fix race condition.
race_instances.shared_object: received state and async wait future ordering
race_instances.trigger_condition: expectation executes before async completion
race_instances.evidence_summary: Assertions are ordered around future.get instead of changing atomics.
race_instances.strict_reason: Test sequencing race repaired through happens-before/future ordering, not a proven non-atomic access.

race_instances.title: Action client goal UUID shared RNG data race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: TSan issue closed by merged PR #3183 and backports.
race_instances.trigger_condition: multiple threads send goals concurrently
race_instances.evidence_summary: Goal-ID RNG access is serialized.
race_instances.strict_reason: std::mt19937 mutable state is concurrently modified without locking.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: No mutex before PR #3183; TSan confirms conflict.

race_instances.title: Context double/reentrant shutdown transaction race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged PR makes shutdown once/reentrancy protocol robust.
race_instances.trigger_condition: multiple shutdown calls or callback reenters shutdown
race_instances.evidence_summary: Once-state and recursive reentrancy guard the compound shutdown transaction.
race_instances.strict_reason: Compound atomicity/reentrancy defect rather than a strict memory data race.

race_instances.title: Isolated component container creates overlapping managers
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Issue closed by merged PR #3223.
race_instances.trigger_condition: temporary and final manager lifetimes overlap in discovery
race_instances.evidence_summary: Temporary manager is removed from startup design.
race_instances.strict_reason: Lifecycle/discovery naming race rather than same-memory access.

race_instances.title: CBG scheduler in_queue check outside mutex
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged PR and backports move in_queue check into ready-callback-group mutex.
race_instances.trigger_condition: multiple ready events occur concurrently
race_instances.evidence_summary: in_queue check is moved under ready_callback_groups_mutex.
race_instances.strict_reason: Plain queue-membership state was checked/updated concurrently outside its intended mutex.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: Check was outside mutex before PR #3234.

race_instances.title: Client send/insert pending-request transaction race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Race reproduction/root-cause issue #2068 and merged PR #2044/backport #2076.

race_instances.trigger_condition: response arrives after send but before map insertion
race_instances.evidence_summary: Pending entry is established consistently with request send.
race_instances.strict_reason: Individual map accesses are locked; send-plus-insert lacks transaction atomicity.

race_instances.title: TimerBase rcl_timer_t API access data race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Maintainer-authored issue explicitly states rcl functions are not thread-safe and need a mutex; unmerged developer commit exists.
race_instances.trigger_condition: cancel/reset overlaps executor timer use
race_instances.impact: undefined behavior in non-thread-safe rcl API
race_instances.evidence_summary: Issue later closed, but no merged mainline fix was located; cited commit was an unmerged developer attempt.
race_instances.strict_reason: Maintainer identifies concurrent calls on a non-thread-safe rcl_timer_t.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: No mutex in affected mainline implementation; fix attempt adds one.

race_instances.title: Executor cancel-before-spin state ordering race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Maintainer explicitly accepts the race; duplicate #3172 closed by merged PR #3174.
race_instances.trigger_condition: cancel happens immediately before spin.exchange(true)
race_instances.evidence_summary: Atomic values were safe individually but state transition lost an earlier cancel.
race_instances.strict_reason: Atomic state-protocol order race, not a strict memory data race.

race_instances.title: Reentrant Waitable ready/take transaction race

race_instances.trigger_condition: reentrant workers both observe ready before one dequeues
race_instances.evidence_summary: Readiness and take/execute transaction is serialized.
race_instances.strict_reason: TOCTOU across logically atomic readiness/dequeue operations.
